title: Ouch. Let that question sit for a minute. 🛑
paragraphs: Ouch. Let that question sit for a minute. 🛑
The hardest verses to read are the ones that apply specifically to our own secret struggles. A real warrior fights the battle within before trying to conquer anyone else.
"Why do you see the speck that is in your brother's eye, but do not notice the log that is in your own eye?" — Matthew 7:3
